entities.name: 新酒 pole with its bar and banner
entities.what: Tall free-standing wooden pole in front of the mat canopy, topped by a small crossbar and a bird-shaped wind vane (the bird's head points west), with a crossed X-frame of two slats lower down; from the pole a long horizontal bar runs west at v ≈ 905 to the 彩楼欢门 scaffold, and from the bar's east half hangs the 新酒 banner: a long pale cloth with three dark vertical bands (both edges and the middle), the two characters 新酒 written faintly in the middle band's light panel, top to bottom.
entities.vis: part: the pole's foot is hidden behind the 串车's load (the pole shows down to v ≈ 1313)
entities.note: Pole centre u 17605 at the vane (v 707), 17610 at the bar (v 905), 17623 at v 1200 (two edge strokes at u 17618 and 17628): it leans a little, top to the west. Base est: the pole runs down behind (north of) the 串车, whose top is at v ≈ 1305 and whose ground line is at v ≈ 1545; the stall stands under the canopy stand at v ≈ 1255-1275, the man north of the cart (S3.fig.man_north_of_chuanche_17690) at v ≈ 1440 est: base est (17630, 1400) ± 60 px of v. Vane: a bird with its beak at (17582, 708) and its tail up to (17637, 678); a short crossbar at v 739 (u 17595-17620). X-frame: two crossed slats about 75 px long centred at (17607, 818), arms reaching u 17570-17650, v 785-850. Bar: a thick dark line at v 902-910 from the pole west to about u 17265, where it runs into the scaffold's east poles (u ≈ 17265-17325): the bar's west end is tied to the 彩楼欢门 (structures_w). Two guy ropes run from the banner's top west corner (17430, 912) down south-west to about (17335-17350, 1110-1125), where they meet the big parasol's rim and a slanting pole (t3's area; t3 reads their ends at ≈ (17330, 1150-1200)). Banner: u 17428-17562, v 915-1125; dark bands at u 17432-17452, 17480-17505 (dark at v 925-985 and 1050-1125) and 17540-17560; the two characters at u 17485-17502, v 985-1045 are faint strokes only (read as 新酒 with the pin; the restyle garbles them). The pole is about 700 px tall from the vane to the est foot. SCALE CUE: banner 135 px wide, 210 px long.

entities.name: 串车 heaped with a bound load
entities.what: 串车 (a barrow-type cart) standing in the open ground in front of the canopy, its huge domed load bound with ropes: a mass of looping, scribbled strokes under big arched hoops, vertical stakes at its west end and a ribbed woven panel (a rolled mat or a basket) at its north-east; two long poles stick out east from the load's top with loops of rope hanging from them, and two long handles run down west-south-west almost to the ground. Nothing draws it: no animal and no puller is painted at either end; two men work at its west (handle) end (t3's).
entities.vis: part: wheel and body hidden by the load; the men at the west end hide the handles' roots
entities.src: 名画记: 串车 (pin 24); 余辉: 书屏遭废 (its load a cursive-script screen used as a tarp)
entities.note: FRONT/REAR: front = east. The two long handles at the west end lie low (tips at about (17440, 1525) and (17455, 1545), only 20-30 px above the cart's ground line), as a barrow's handles do when it is set down, and the two men at that end (t3's: a capped man at head (17543, 1325) and a man with a topknot at head (17500, 1335)) face east and lean into the load. The east end has no shafts at ground level, only the load's poles at v 1320-1345 and hanging rope loops (u 17760-17790, down to v ≈ 1495, one ending in a hook). Reading B: the west poles are shafts and the cart faces west; then its front would be (17440, 1530) and it would be t3's. LOAD: 余辉 reads it as a cursive-script screen used as a tarp; the strokes show dense looping lines that could be cursive writing or a tangle of ropes and sticks (the restyle paints a tangle of timber). WHEEL: the big arcs (top v ≈ 1305 at u 17560-17700, east side to u ≈ 17770, lower rim v ≈ 1540-1550 at u 17590-17680) read as one big wheel about 240 px across, hub ≈ (17640, 1430), half hidden by the load (like S5.veh.cart_screen_8510's one big wheel); they could also be the hoops over the load, so the wheel contact is est. Two short dark uprights under the body at (17512, 1550) and (17605, 1562) are the barrow's rest legs, or the feet of a man hidden behind the load. SCALE CUES: load 320 px long (u 17470-17790) and 245 px high (v 1305-1550). DEPTH DIRECTION: none drawn; the cart is side-on (handle line (17560, 1490) -> (17440, 1525), slope -0.29, runs down to the west, not a receding edge). SEAM: the cart spans t3 and t4; t3's part agrees it is t4's (front east, handles resting on the ground at the west); t3's two men at its west end are S3.fig.topknot_man_at_cart_17458 and S3.fig.cap_man_at_cart_17545 (join them to S3.grp.chuanche_17775 at merge).

entities.name: the 串车 and the men at it
entities.what: The heaped 串车 standing at the tavern side of the open ground, two men working at its load from the west (handle) end and a man standing just north of it.
entities.note: t3's S3.fig.topknot_man_at_cart_17458 and S3.fig.cap_man_at_cart_17545 belong here: the merge adds them.

entities.name: black donkey balking
entities.what: Black (dark grey-brown) donkey seen from behind and the west side, its rump toward the viewer at the south-west and its head away to the north-east; its hind legs are braced far back on the ground while a halter rope runs taut from its head up north-east toward the second cart and the bearded man hauling at its front (t5's). A light strap curves over its rump (a breeching or crupper); no saddle or load.
entities.vis: part: head seen from behind; the near foreleg alone shows
entities.note: Body u 17913-18041, v 1483-1587. Hind hooves at (17912, 1660) and (17958, 1640) (hind = their midpoint); the foreleg comes down at u 18043-18053 to a hoof at (18048, 1586); the other foreleg is hidden. A small isolated stroke at (18080, 1590) is a tuft on the ground, not a hoof. Head: a tuft of ears or mane at (18045-18060, 1505-1530) where the rope is tied. The rope runs to about (18117, 1440), at the front of t5's barrow S3.veh.barrow_hooped_load_18100, by the hands of t5's bearded man S3.fig.bearded_barrow_man_18098: the donkey is that barrow's draught animal, balking (join it to t5's S3.grp.barrow_18100 at merge). Both restyles agree it is seen from behind with its head north-east (the tile restyle makes it an ox). Reading: a donkey balking while it is hauled toward the cart, or tied behind the cart. SCALE CUE: body 125 px long. SEAM: its fore is at u 18048, two px inside t4's range; t5 may record it too.

entities.name: flat mat canopy over the stalls
entities.what: Large flat canopy of dark woven matting on posts, seen obliquely from above, sheltering the stalls between the 新酒 pole and the official: a jar-and-bottle stand, a goods table and a food stand with its customers. Its west end slants, and the 新酒 pole stands just in front of its south-west corner.
entities.vis: part: posts hidden by the people and stalls under it
entities.note: Mat edges (strokes): front (south) edge v 1093 from u 17598 to 17868; back (north) edge v 943 from u 17640 to 17950; the west edge slants from (17640, 943) to (17598, 1093); the east end is overlapped by the lighter lattice awning (S3.prop.lattice_mat_awning_17840). Posts glimpsed at u 17643 (v 1135-1250), 17680 (v 1080-1150) and 17903-17910 (v 1100-1300). Base corners est: the ground under the front edge from the stall stands' feet (v 1255-1275), under the back edge from a canopy height of ≈ 185 px (≈ 2.4 m). A shed or a canopy on poles: recorded as a prop like S4.prop.mat_awning_12066; if structures_w records it as a shed, keep one (seam note in the report). Merge: structures_w recorded the same mat roof as a building, S3.bld.mat_shed_17590 (retired: a flat mat roof on posts, open on all sides, over stalls is an awning on its own poles, a tile prop). Its reading adds posts at u 17838 (v 1081-1131) and 17880 (v 1060-1150), a roof about 2.5 m up at the front (192 px) sloping up to the back, and a west edge sloping -2.9 (a mat edge in the air, skewed in plan against the ground edges nearby at -1.0 to -1.1).

entities.name: sloping mat awning with a bamboo lattice
entities.what: Large woven-mat awning stiffened with a diagonal lattice of bamboo slats, sloping from the bank's edge by the moored boats down toward the south; it overlaps the flat canopy's east end and shelters the stall east of the official.
entities.vis: part: its north edge meets the hull of the moored boat; the parasol (t5's) covers its north-east corner
entities.note: Lattice mat strokes u 17780-18170, v 921-1105: back edge just south of the moored boat's hull (v ≈ 935 at u 17790), front edge v ≈ 1100. Its posts are not seen; the base corners are placeholders (front at the stall people's feet, v ≈ 1290; back ≈ 185 px below the back edge). Reading B: the mat cover of the boat moored at the bank, hanging down over the bank (river_w's; its part reads the mats as the unloading boat's stern cover, or a stall awning on the bank); the strokes put it on land, south of the hull's lower edge (river_w's waterline (17870, 900) -> (18000, 925) -> (18050, 940)). se est at t5's post foot (18078-18095, 1060-1207). SEAM: t5's first draft recorded the same awning as lattice_mat_awning_18060 (roof u 17877-18185, v 934-1083, sw est (17995, 1150)); its current part drops it and names this one in S3.grp.parasol_stall_18160, whose stall it shelters.
